findings.short_summary: Open Lots/Realized/Tax tabs have detail-level rows (one per lot/gain/accrual), violating spec's 'one row per entity'
findings.description: Spec requires 'one row per entity' for each tab. Code implements: Open Lots = one row per open lot (multiple per entity), Realized = one row per realized gain (multiple per entity), Tax accruals = one row per accrual (multiple per entity), Tax reserve = one row per (jurisdiction, tax_year) (multiple per entity). Verified by render_open_lots (line 606), render_realized (line 661), render_tax (lines 710, 726), and explicit test assertions (tabs.rs lines 47, 49). All three B-outputs correctly identify this behavior; all three A-outputs expect aggregation per entity.
findings.failure_scenario: User applies spec literally ('one row per entity' per tab) but finds data has multiple rows per entity. Native Sheets filter-by-entity yields multiple rows, breaking the intended 'one row per entity → entity is the filtering unit' design.
